bead.title: Add S3-compatible fjord object-log constructor and config tests
bead.description:
PROBLEM: `pqueue-objectlog` can validate abstract object-log semantics, but it has no concrete S3-compatible runtime constructor for MinIO/S3, so deployment readiness cannot prove the durable log path.

ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/lib.rs:22` and `crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/lib.rs:23` only re-export fjord memory helpers; `crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/lib.rs:120` through `crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/lib.rs:145` construct `FjordObjectLogStore` from an injected `BlobStore` or in-memory `MemoryBlobStore`, with no endpoint/bucket/region/credential-based S3-compatible constructor.

PROPOSED FIX: Add an S3-compatible object-log configuration type and constructor/adapter in `crates/pqueue-objectlog/**` that builds the fjord blob path from endpoint, bucket, region, credentials, path-style/MinIO compatibility, conditional-write capability, and segment settings. Validate production safety rules and expose explicit errors for missing credentials, invalid bucket/endpoint, unsupported CAS behavior without fallback, and unsafe one-command segments.

GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: Parent bead `pqueue-3546063c`; `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md`; `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md`; `docs/deployment/container-runtime-contract.md`.

NON-SCOPE: Cloud-provider-specific IAM/TLS hardening beyond an S3-compatible MinIO proof. Replacing the existing fjord object-log abstraction or queue semantics. Helm chart edits, kind MinIO orchestration, and deployment documentation changes are handled by sibling beads.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestS3CompatibleConstructorConfig: `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog -- --nocapture` passes and includes tests proving valid MinIO/S3-compatible endpoint, bucket, region, credentials, segment settings, path-style mode, and conditional-write/fallback configuration are accepted.
2. TestS3CompatibleConstructorRejectsInvalidConfig: `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog -- --nocapture` passes and includes negative tests for missing endpoint, bucket, credentials, invalid segment settings, and production-unsafe manifest/segment combinations.
3. TestObjectLogRegressionSuite: existing object-log recovery, fencing, manifest, and memory-backed tests continue to pass under `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog -- --nocapture`.
4. TestQualityGates: `go test ./...` and `lefthook run pre-commit` pass from the repository root, alongside the Rust command in AC1.
